name: footlit-video
description: Renders the Footlit launch film from the real engine, frame by frame

scripts.all: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-audio.mjs && node scripts/render.mjs --full
scripts.teaser: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/make-teaser-audio.mjs && node scripts/render.mjs --film=teaser --full --crf=12
